claim: The AWS database decision guide lists ElastiCache as an in-memory database to use when you need a caching layer to improve read performance, optimized for microsecond reads and sub-millisecond writes as an ephemeral cache for frequently accessed data.
question: When does the AWS database decision guide say to use ElastiCache?

values.display: a caching layer to improve read performance
an ephemeral cache for frequently accessed data
